name: Hatsukoi * Syndrome
source:
Everyone says that your first love never comes true. Yuuto thinks that it is indeed true since he, like most others around him, had lost his first love. But unlike the others, his broken heart has still not healed to this day.

Looking at the watch that his first love Haruka had gave to him as a present, he decided that he will finally move on from the past. He resolved to bury the watch under the giant cherry blossom tree on the school grounds, which is said to be seen as being in full bloom by those who are in love, and cut loose from his past regrets. However, there was a girl wearing an unfamiliar school uniform who had arrived there before him, looking up at the cherry blossom tree. Lunalight noticed him and asked him a question while smiling:

“Do you want to fall in love?”

The magician-in-training Lunalight wished to experience first love and also breaking up, in order to understand love and become a full-fledged magician. It was a fateful first meeting for Yuuto, who was still bound by his first love. He would also be reunited with the girl from his past, who had given up her first love to become a magician. What will become of the futures of these three, who are held captive by first love?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/04/01/april-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
每个人都说你的初恋永远不会实现。雄斗认为这确实是真的，因为他和周围的大多数人一样，失去了初恋。但与其他人不同的是，他受伤的心至今仍未痊愈。

看着初恋遥送给自己的手表作为礼物，他决定终于要告别过去了。他决定将手表埋在学校操场上那棵据说被恋爱中的人视为盛开的樱花树下，以此斩断过去的遗憾。然而，有一个穿着陌生校服的女孩比他先到了那里，抬头看着那棵樱花树。月光注意到了他，微笑着问了他一个问题：

“你想谈恋爱吗？”

魔法师实习生月光希望经历初恋和分手，从而理解爱情，成为一名真正的魔法师。对于仍被初恋束缚的勇斗来说，这是一次命运般的初次相遇。他也将与过去的那个为了成为魔法师而放弃初恋的女孩重逢。被初恋俘虏的三人的未来将会怎样？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/04/01/april-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
